items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: And one is a duet with Dianne Reeves.

ctx.x: Every day is a challenge. Even now that you’re going to be doing this concert, and you’ve been playing concerts more years than — a lot of years. Do you still feel it’s a challenge to go on?

Oh, Lord yes. I’m doing three things written by Benny Carter that I’ve never performed. And one is a duet with Dianne Reeves. And she is like, oh, talk about holding someone in awe, and admiring somebody greatly. That lady, she’s such a musician and such a voice, such a presence, such beauty and warmth and it’s really —
